headline: Sensex Jumps Over 500 Points Led by FMCG Stocks and FII Inflows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign institutional investor (FII) buying supported the market rally.
Strong buying interest in FMCG and banking stocks lifted benchmark indices.
Positive performance in the BSE Insurance index contributed to sector gains.
Broader market indices closed near key resistance levels including Nifty near 25,300.
whatHappening: Sensex gained over 500 points while Nifty50 closed near 25,291.
Max Healthcare emerged as a top gainer during the session.
Tata Motors PV fell 8.7% after JLR trimmed its FY27 margin guidance.
RBI reiterated its directive for Tata Sons to fulfill upper-layer NBFC listing requirements.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty closed over 0.5% higher, supported by foreign fund buying and strong performance in FMCG and banking stocks. Max Healthcare was among the top gainers, whereas Tata Motors slumped following a cut in JLR's FY27 margin outlook. Additionally, the RBI reiterated its listing mandate for Tata Sons.
